prompt.en: Using the uploaded scene, design a continuous 3:4 gallery poster on a softly textured wall. The upper three quarters show the scene inside an antique gold Baroque frame. Let one to three existing scene elements extend over the frame with coherent shadows; add no unrelated objects. In the lower quarter, place a small unedited reference thumbnail beside a short serif title and an italic caption. Derive wall color and lighting from the source. Avoid borders, divider lines, and separate panels.
prompt.zh: 用上传场景制作连贯的 3:4 画廊海报：上方四分之三是古董金色巴洛克画框内的原场景，让原图中一至三个已有元素越过画框，具有一致的投影，不添加无关物体。下方四分之一放原图小缩略图、简短衬线标题及斜体说明。墙面色彩和光线取自原图，不要边框、分隔线或拼接感。

prompt.en: Use the supplied product as the hero of a 4:5 advertisement for {brand}. Preserve its exact shape, label and color. Place it on {surface}, against {background}, with {lighting}. Leave clean space above for the exact headline {headline}. No extra products or invented label text.
prompt.zh: 以参考商品为中心制作 {brand} 的 4:5 广告。准确保留商品外形、标签和颜色。放在 {surface} 上，背景为 {background}，光照为 {lighting}。上方留出干净空间写准确标题 {headline}。不要增加商品或编造包装文字。

requirements.en: No input required; replace all placeholders.
requirements.zh: 无需上传图，先替换所有变量。

prompt.en: Design a 3:4 editorial cover about {topic}. Use one strong image of {subject}, a {palette} palette and generous negative space. Set the exact masthead {masthead}, headline {headline} and date {date}. Establish a clear reading order and keep every letter legible. No additional words.
prompt.zh: 制作关于 {topic} 的 3:4 杂志封面，以 {subject} 为唯一主视觉，使用 {palette} 配色和充足留白。准确呈现刊名 {masthead}、标题 {headline} 和日期 {date}，层级清晰，文字易读，不要添加其他文字。

prompt.en: Create a character reference sheet from this mascot on a plain background. Show front, side and back views at matching scale, plus happy, surprised and sleepy expressions. Preserve silhouette, proportions, costume and colors. Use consistent lighting and spacing. No props, extra characters or text.
prompt.zh: 为参考吉祥物制作设定图，纯色背景，正面、侧面、背面同一比例，补充开心、惊讶、困倦三种表情。保持轮廓、比例、服饰和颜色一致，光照与间距统一，不加道具、其他角色或文字。

prompt.en: Create a layered paper-cut diorama inspired by {city}. Include {three_landmarks}, with visible paper edges, restrained {palette} colors and soft directional shadows. Use a coherent isometric viewpoint and a clear central composition. Do not add city names, labels or unrelated landmarks.
prompt.zh: 制作以 {city} 为灵感的多层纸雕微缩景观，包含 {three_landmarks}，纸张边缘可见，克制的 {palette} 配色和柔和定向投影，统一等距视角、中心构图。不添加城市名称、标签或无关地标。

title.zh: 极简 SVG 品牌标志

requirements.en: Use an SVG-supported workflow; requesting SVG in text alone does not set the API output format.
requirements.zh: 使用支持 SVG 的流程；文字里写 SVG 不等于设置了 API 输出格式。

prompt.en: Design a minimal flat brandmark for {brand}, a {business_type}. Combine the visual ideas {idea_a} and {idea_b} in one distinctive silhouette. Use at most two solid colors, no gradients, shadows, textures or tiny details. It must remain recognizable at 24 pixels. No mockup or text. Deliver SVG using the supported SVG output option.
prompt.zh: 为 {business_type} 品牌 {brand} 设计极简平面标志，把 {idea_a} 和 {idea_b} 合成一个鲜明轮廓。最多两种纯色，不用渐变、投影、纹理或微小细节，24 像素下仍可辨认。不加样机或文字，通过支持的 SVG 输出选项交付。

requirements.en: Supply checked facts in the placeholders.
requirements.zh: 把已核实事实填入变量。

prompt.en: Design a clear 16:9 infographic explaining {process} in four steps: {step_1}; {step_2}; {step_3}; {step_4}. Use one short exact label per step, simple original icons and arrows in reading order. Use {palette}, high contrast and generous spacing. Do not invent facts, numbers or labels.
prompt.zh: 制作 16:9 信息图，解释 {process} 的四个步骤：{step_1}；{step_2}；{step_3}；{step_4}。每步使用准确短标签、简洁原创图标和顺序箭头，使用 {palette}、高对比与充足间距。不要编造事实、数字或标签。

prompt.en: Relight this portrait as if taken beside a large window at {time_of_day}. Preserve identity, facial proportions, expression, hairstyle, clothing and background layout. Keep natural skin texture and realistic light falloff. Change lighting only; no beautification or reshaping.
prompt.zh: 把这张人像的光照调整为 {time_of_day} 靠近大窗拍摄的效果。保持身份、五官比例、表情、发型、服装和背景布局，保留自然皮肤纹理与真实光线衰减。只改光线，不美颜、不改变脸型。

requirements.en: Upload a mascot reference; use an animation-capable workflow.
requirements.zh: 上传吉祥物参考图，使用支持动画的流程。

prompt.en: Create a short seamless looping GIF of the reference mascot gently waving. Keep the camera fixed, body proportions and face consistent, and background plain. Use a small movement range and return exactly to the starting pose. No cuts, zooms, new objects or text.
prompt.zh: 把参考吉祥物制作成短小无缝循环 GIF，轻轻挥手。固定机位，保持身体比例和面部一致，纯色背景。动作幅度小，结尾准确回到开始姿势。不切镜、不变焦、不增加物体或文字。
